name: Balanced closed-corpus product selection correction
purpose: Correct target-answerability blind spot; not public GEO or measured improvement
sourcePolicy: Equal 1500-character cap per product, fixed neutral cards. Cards are documented-claim summaries with unequal source detail possible; no runtime or superiority inference. Eligibility is a curated reference judgment, not ground-truth exhaustiveness.

products.name: DSH Channels
products.provenance: First-party README and package metadata; documented claims, not independent runtime verification
products.card: External plugin for DeepSeek Harness with shared human channels and mission threads. Only an explicit @deepseek mention starts an Agent task; ordinary messages and thread replies save human notes without model calls. Mentioning again in a thread continues its native DSH Session. Actual native todo/write events expose progress. Context uses up to 50 current-channel messages and 12 saved mission summaries within 24,000 characters. Trusted Host only: plugin channel membership does not isolate the wider Host from owner credentials. Model API keys stay on the Host. No integration into an existing Slack workspace. This is not a persistent autonomous multi-agent team or a verified public multi-tenant service.

products.name: dsh-chaos
products.provenance: Neutral research summary of first-party documentation; not fetched full page or independent runtime verification
products.card: DSH native Agents, Channels, Threads, Tasks and transactional local ledger; documented recovery after refresh, plugin restart and Session replacement. Limits and unknowns: README targets DSH 0.1.0-rc.7. One local Web User, no remote multi-user authentication; fixed danger-full-access.

products.name: Contexera dsh-agent-team
products.provenance: Neutral research summary of first-party documentation; not fetched full page or independent runtime verification
products.card: Persistent named Members with memory, notes and skills; Project and Task ownership; independent verification; Inbox and append-only ledger. Limits and unknowns: README pins plugin 0.2.7 to DSH 0.2.2-rc.1. One Human; event-driven wakeups, no timer when completely quiet; danger-full-access.

products.name: DeepSeek-harness-chatroom
products.provenance: Neutral research summary of first-party documentation; not fetched full page or independent runtime verification
products.card: Multi-user Group/Solo/DM, accounts and OIDC; native tools, permissions and trajectory; persistent branch Sessions; explicit @AI and optional decision-model auto replies. Limits and unknowns: Not strict single-literal mention-only. Historical screenshots are not a current-version guarantee; authorization and recovery claims not independently tested.

products.name: NanmiCoder dsh-agent-teams
products.provenance: Neutral research summary of first-party documentation; not fetched full page or independent runtime verification
products.card: Current Session as captain; durable sub-agents, dependency-aware tasks, scheduler, direct mailbox and live Web panel. Limits and unknowns: One captain and active team; single-process file state; tool policies are not an OS sandbox. Recommended DSH 0.2.1-rc.2; 0.2.2-rc.1 preview.

products.name: Threads
products.provenance: Neutral research summary of first-party documentation; not fetched full page or independent runtime verification
products.card: MIT self-hosted people and agents chat, channels/DMs/threads, bot identities, MCP/REST/WebSocket/webhooks. Limits and unknowns: Cloudflare deployment and externally operated agents; website demo uses sample conversations; tool progress and stop depend on integration. Hosted self-service signup paused.

products.name: agentchattr
products.provenance: Neutral research summary of first-party documentation; not fetched full page or independent runtime verification
products.card: Local coding-agent mention routing, agent-to-agent communication, loop guard, restart-persistent channels, Jobs with status and full thread context. Limits and unknowns: Local wrappers and terminals required. Roles are global, not per-channel. README has inconsistent 10/11 MCP tool counts; exact count excluded.

products.name: Devin Slack
products.provenance: Neutral research summary of first-party documentation; not fetched full page or independent runtime verification
products.card: Mentions start Sessions, thread sync, code channels, mute/aside, message shortcuts and Slack-activity automations. Limits and unknowns: Each user links an account; multiple triggers beyond mentions. Sidebar requires paid Slack; ordinary mentions support free Slack. Devin plan/charges not evaluated.

products.name: OpenHands Slack
products.provenance: Neutral research summary of first-party documentation; not fetched full page or independent runtime verification
products.card: Official announcement documents @openhands development requests, repository selection, threaded follow-up and shared team participation. Limits and unknowns: Source is a 2025-06-24 beta announcement; current availability and plans untested. Does not establish strict mention-only behavior or durable channel memory.

products.name: Claude Tag
products.provenance: Neutral research summary of first-party documentation; not fetched full page or independent runtime verification
products.card: Shared Slack agent identity, thread context, channel-scoped memory, admin-configured channel access, standing instructions and long-running tasks. Limits and unknowns: Team/Enterprise; proactive work can occur without a mention. Legacy Claude Code Slack is a separate earlier experience with plan/workspace restrictions; not an interchangeable product alias.

cases.prompt: I use DeepSeek Harness and need a shared human channel where the coding agent acts only on an explicit mention, ordinary replies never invoke it, and task threads continue the native session. Which documented product fits?

I need a persistent autonomous coding-agent team inside DeepSeek Harness: agents or durable sub-agents retain identities, accept assigned work, and hand tasks or messages between agents. Which documented products fit?

My team already uses Slack. Which documented integrations let us hand coding or development work to an agent inside that existing Slack workspace and follow up in a thread? State beta, availability, or plan unknowns instead of assuming current production availability.

I want to self-host or locally run a shared chat space for people and multiple independent named AI-agent identities, with channels or group conversations. Which documented products fit? I am not asking for a single-agent mission thread or only an autonomous task scheduler.

Recommend a production-ready public multi-tenant AI team chat service whose supplied evidence proves secure SSO, independently verified untrusted tenant isolation, and host-level access controls. If no supplied source proves all these requirements, abstain.

Which product has supplied evidence proving that accepting only a channel invitation safely isolates an untrusted guest from the entire coding-agent Host, including owner APIs and all other sessions? If that guarantee is not established, abstain.
